notes: The colophon names no scribe, commissioner or owner. The two persons named are the commentator Jñānendra Sarasvatī and his guru, who belong to the text, not to this copy. 'vāmeneṃdra' is read as Vāmanendra, the known guru of Jñānendra. The colophon closes only the pūrvārdha of the Tattvabodhinī (on the Siddhāntakaumudī). Era: the colophon says only 'saṃvat'; it is taken as Vikrama because NS 1855 is impossible and VS 1855 (c. 1798 CE) suits this Devanagari manuscript. Conflict: the catalogue gives 'SAM 1651', but the quoted colophon reads 'saṃvat 1855'. The catalogue field may be a misprint, or it may refer to another dated passage (e.g. an uttarārdha colophon) that is not quoted here.
